title: Zesty Silky Australian Rice Bowl
description: A festive, grain‑centric bowl that marries sous‑vide infused Vialone Nano rice with crisp summer veggies, all finished on a hot tava‑griddle for silky texture and zesty flavor.
instructions: Rinse the Vialone Nano rice until the water runs clear and pack it with 500ml water and 1 tsp salt into a vacuum‑seal bag.
Seal the bag and immerse it in a preheated sous‑vide water bath at 96°C for 30 minutes.
After cooking, remove the bag, drain excess water, and spread the rice onto a heated tava‑griddle until the surface turns golden and silky.
While the rice sears, heat coconut oil in a small skillet and toast mustard seeds until they pop, then add turmeric and chili flakes to smoke slightly.
Stir the toasted spices into the rice, sprinkling the caramelized oil over it for a fragrant coating.
In a bowl, whisk lime juice, tamarind paste, and peanut butter until smooth, creating a zesty glaze.
Toss the diced cucumber, julienned carrot, shredded red cabbage, and chopped coriander into the rice, then pour the glaze over and mix gently.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds and roasted seaweed flakes on top for crunch and umami depth.
Serve immediately, letting each diner savour the silky rice and bright, festive vegetables.
